1.17.3+261029 (2026-10-31)

MML maps work again (#165)

The National Land Survey of Finland (MML) maps in the TAK client packages load again. The map list is now:

1 MML Maastokartta, 2 MML Ilmakuva, 3 MML Taustakartta (new), 4 Google Hybrid, 5 Google Satellite, 6 Google Roadmap.

Terrain data for ATAK (#165)

ATAK packages include terrain sources (high and mid resolution), so elevation data is available in the map.
